title: Mixed Event — Hello to a New Day! — Episode1 A New Day

meta.Event Outline: It's the start of a new school year and everyone has gone up a grade! That fact hasn't quite hit Ichika yet, but when Miku asks to see the opening ceremony, it spurs her to treat it like a special day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Let's see...
I've got my pencil case and folders...

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Ichika!
You're going to be late for the opening ceremony if you keep dallying.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh...
Don't worry! I'll be out the door soon!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I don't really feel like one.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Miku!
What are you doing here at this time of day?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I wanted to see how you were doing. You're a second-year starting today, right?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I became a little curious.
I was hoping to see what your new class and opening ceremony are going to be like.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean... Neither is going to feel all that special. I'm not sure if there'll be anything worth seeing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Really? I consider it a big day since it marks the beginning of so many new things.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
New things...
Yeah, I guess you're right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Ichika!
I'm serious! You're going to be late!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's my cue to head out...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'll keep my phone in my pocket.
You should be fine as long as you stay hidden while you watch like usual.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Wow.
There's a ton of people gathered over there.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm guessing they've posted the new class rosters by the front entrance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see. That explains the buzz in the air.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Morning, Ichi!
Hey, about the new class rosters...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Good morning, Saki.
You're as peppy as ever this morning.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! Miku?!
What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I wanted to see what you girls are like now that you're second-years, as well as the opening ceremony.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <While staying hidden from view, of course.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?!
That means you also get to share in this fun and exciting moment!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're gonna take a look at the new rosters now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's so fun and exciting because we get to find out who we're going to be with this upcoming year!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, Saki, you haven't seen them yet...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nope!
I wanted to see them as a group!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: ...which is how we ended up waiting here for what felt like forever.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Miku, good morning.
I didn't realize you'd be joining us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Were you all waiting for me to get here? Sorry about that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was also hoping that we'd get to look at them together. It is always more fun that way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! That was my point exactly!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't have a problem with looking at them alone, but Saki insisted.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, relax.
We're all here now, so let's go take a look before the bell rings.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think we're close enough to see them now. Let's see... We're...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, there!
I'm in Class A.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ichika!
We're in the same class!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?! You are?!
What about me...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nooo! I'm not in Class A!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki, look over there.
You're in Class B.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm not with Ichi and Hona...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, you're not with them. Instead...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait!
Shiho, Saki, you're in the same class!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Okay, try to calm down...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Everyone!
If you've already found your names, please start making your way towards your classes to prevent unnecessary crowding!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I was just feeling glad that I came over.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You said it wouldn't feel all that special, Ichika, but I'm having a lot of fun.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I got to see that look of anticipation on your faces, the joy you felt when you found out you'd be in the same classes, all sorts of things.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Like something new is really about to start today.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had it in my mind that we'd just be shuffling classes and going to a new classroom...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Today's a day that marks the beginning of a lot of new things.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm going to start treating this day like it's special and really try to cherish it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Try to have as much fun as you can today, Ichika!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, Miku, I hope you'll take a good look at what happens at our school and see how we all do today.
